shortDescription: By Toby SterlingDutch chipmaker Nexperia said on Thursday it will partner with Tata Electronics, a subsidiary of the Tata Group, to produce and package chips in India.Nexperia is owned, but not controlled, by Wingtech SSE:600745 of China, following a dispute last year.
